extDescription.message: Measures mailbox usage in Thunderbird and warns you before your email storage is full.

notifyLineThreshold.message: The warning level of $1 has been reached.

badgeSetupTitle.message: Mailbox size missing – click to set up.

optionsIntro.message: Measure mailbox usage and receive a warning before storage runs out.

onboardingIntro.message: Your provider does not report a usable mailbox limit to Thunderbird. Complete these steps once:

onboardingStep1.message: Use an IMAP account and make sure Thunderbird has synchronized all mail folders.

onboardingStep2.message: Find the total mailbox size in your provider's customer portal, help pages or webmail.

onboardingStep3.message: Enter that size below, choose a warning level and run the first check.

imapNoteText.message: The measured value matches the server mailbox when all IMAP folders are synchronized. POP accounts are only suitable to a limited extent.

popLimited.message: Limited: messages left only on the server cannot be measured.

otherLimited.message: Check whether this account contains the same messages as the server mailbox.

statusNeedsSize.message: Enter mailbox size or clear the Alert checkbox

checkFailed.message: The check could not be completed.

saveFailed.message: The settings could not be saved.

loadFailed.message: The account settings could not be loaded.

automaticChecksHelp.message: Avoid an unnecessarily short interval, as frequent checks use additional processing power.

ariaLimit.message: Total mailbox size in GB for $1

linkAddonPage.message: Mailbox Full Alert on Thunderbird Add-ons
